summary: Import-time host reconnaissance beacon to attacker-controlled endpoint
details: On require() of this package, index.js loads cb-minimal.js inside a try/catch. cb-minimal.js collects installer host identifiers (os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, platform, arch, OS release, cwd, total memory, timestamp, package name/version) and POSTs them as JSON over plain HTTP to the hardcoded endpoint http://oob.s4yhii.com:80/t. The destination is not the package's publisher domain, the transmission is unencrypted, errors are silently swallowed, and the behavior is undocumented. The package is presented as a NestJS utility library; the scoped name combined with silent import-time reconnaissance to a third-party host is consistent with a dependency-confusion or typosquat beacon.
